model: A named ML model, architecture, or checkpoint (e.g. LeafScan-v3, ResNet-50).
dataset: A named dataset or data split (e.g. PlantVillage-ext, the field set).
experiment: A named experiment or training run id (e.g. exp-dedup).
hyperparameter: A named training or preprocessing setting (e.g. resize interpolation, class weights).
